description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour script called AddingAudio, which manages playing audio clips based on user touch interactions with specific game objects in a scene.

classes.name: AddingAudio
classes.description: A MonoBehaviour class that handles touch input to trigger audio playback and toggle visibility of scene objects based on object names.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes references to the AudioSource component and finds game objects by name.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Checks for touch input and performs raycasting to determine which scene object was touched, then plays audio and toggles object visibility accordingly.
